title: Kompilasi Podcast Under The Banana Trees - Archival Network: Jaringan Organisasi Asia Tenggara Untuk Pendokumentasian & Penyebarluasan 'Sejarah Rakyat'.
comment: jaringan Under the Banana Trees anggotanya terdiri dari berbagai organisasi di Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapura, Filipina dan Thailand. 'Under the Banana Tree' is a network of cultural organisations devoted to preserving and sharing 'People's Histories.' These histories challenge official histories of kings and strongmen, and focus on dynamic histories of social, labour, progressive, and feminist movements. ... Baca Selengkapnya
